items.prompt: It's pouring with rain. Oliver says: 'Gorgeous day.' He is being ___.
The presentation went perfectly. Charlotte says: 'That went well.' She is being ___.
items.hintAfterError: Aqui a situação e as palavras dizem a mesma coisa.

items.prompt: The printer jams again. Harry says: 'Brilliant machine.' His tone is ___.
After a genuinely excellent report, the manager says: 'Well done, truly.' This comment is ___.
The team loses a major client. James says: 'Couldn't be happier.' He means he is ___.
items.hintAfterError: Na ironia, a pessoa quer dizer o contrário do que as palavras dizem.
